tool.name: ConvertTpr
tool.description: : Wrapper of the GROMACS convert-tpr module.

param.name: input_tpr_path
param.label: input TPR file
param.help: Path to the input portable binary run file TPR. Format: [input].tpr

param.name: input_ndx_path
param.label: input NDX file
param.help: Path to the input index NDX file, used to trim the tpr file to a subset of atoms. Format: [input].ndx

param.name: outname_output_tpr_path
param.label: output TPR name
param.help: Path to the output portable binary run file TPR Format: [output].tpr

param.name: sele
param.label: Take tool settings:
param.help: Select where tool settings are to be read from

param.name: properties
param.label: Configuration file
param.help: File containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: jsonstr
param.label: JSON string
param.help: JSON string containing tool settings. See below for the syntax

param.name: extend
param.label: extend
param.help: Extend the runtime by this amount (ps).

param.name: until
param.label: until
param.help: Extend the runtime until this ending time (ps).

param.name: nsteps
param.label: nsteps
param.help: Change the number of steps remaining to be made.

param.name: output_group
param.label: output_group
param.help: Index group to write to the output tpr file when trimming to a subset of atoms. Only used when input_ndx_path is provided.

param.name: gmx_lib
param.label: gmx_lib
param.help: Path set GROMACS GMXLIB environment variable.

param.name: binary_path
param.label: binary_path
param.help: Path to the GROMACS executable binary.
